items.raw_excerpt: “短短四年，OpenAI已经官僚大厂化了，Anthropic却依然守着那套Effective Altruism（有效利他主义）信仰，活成了一家宗教。在硅谷，大家都想做大，只有他们想做‘对’。”不久前，硅谷AI创投人Leo向雷峰网如此叹道。 天才扎堆的AI赛场上，一家AI巨头真正的生死命门，从来只有一件事： 如何驯服一群ego很大的聪明人。 当一群大ego的聪明人聚在一起，小到参数微调，大到路线选择，他们往往都各有一套“真理”。若无强力制衡，这群聪明人极易因理念不合掀桌子走人，令团队分崩离析。要想稳住他们，就得建立起超越个人意志的团队共识。 “目前世界上能做到这件事的，要么靠 ChatGPT 之父伊利亚这种封神级科学家亲自带队；要么靠谷歌AI掌门人哈萨比斯这种功勋元老威望压阵；唯独Anthropic是特例 ，它是靠信仰——有效利他主义，让一群顶级天才像信徒一样死心塌地追随。” 在 Anthropic ，他们不比谁的技术更牛，而是比谁能更好建立AI“防火墙”，拯救世界免受AGI安全威胁。对于这群天才而言，高薪与期权已是标配，反倒是这份守护人类安全的救世理想，才能对他们产生无法抗拒的吸引力。 “ 就算哪天Anthropic钱烧光，公司倒闭，只要团队里的人没死，它随时都能卷土重来。 但OpenAI，生死大限就在下半年，一旦上市有闪失，仙童当年分崩离析人才四散的结局或许就是它的未来。”Leo补充道。 而如今，秉持着有效利他主义的 Anthropic 在商业市场上，已兑现出超万亿美元估值和 440亿美元的 ARR，双线弯道超车劲敌 OpenAI ，成为当下炙手可热的超级AI独角兽。 下面，雷峰网通过对话数位来自“中国版 Anthropic”的头部科技企业高管，以及长期跟踪Anthropic的专家与分析师，从路线、产品、生态、组织四个维度，逐一拆解Anthropic的宗教感从何而来？ 更

excerpt_i18n.en: "In just four years, OpenAI has become a bureaucratic giant, while Anthropic still clings to its Effective Altruism faith, living like a religious sect. In Silicon Valley, everyone wants to get bigger, but only they want to do what's 'right,'" Leo, a Silicon Valley AI venture investor, recently lamented to Leiphone. In the AI arena teeming with geniuses, the true life-or-death challenge for an AI giant has always been one thing: how to tame a group of highly ego-driven smart people. When these big-ego geniuses gather, they each have their own "truths," from parameter fine-tuning to strategic direction. Without strong checks and balances, they are prone to walk out over ideological differences, causing the team to collapse. To stabilize them, a team consensus that transcends individual will must be established. "Currently, the only ones in the world capable of this are either led by a god-tier scientist like ChatGPT's father Ilya, or backed by the prestige of a veteran like Google AI chief Hassabis. Anthropic is the exception—it relies on faith: Effective Altruism, making top-tier geniuses follow devoutly like believers." At Anthropic, they don't compete over who has better technology, but over who can better build AI "firewalls" to save the world from AGI security threats. For these geniuses, high salaries and stock options are standard; it's the messianic ideal of protecting humanity that holds an irresistible allure.
excerpt_i18n.es: En solo cuatro años, OpenAI se ha burocratizado como una gran empresa, mientras que Anthropic sigue aferrada a la fe del altruismo efectivo, viviendo como una religión. En Silicon Valley, todos quieren crecer, solo ellos quieren hacer lo "correcto". Hace poco, Leo, un inversor en startups de IA de Silicon Valley, comentó esto a Leiphone. En el campo de la IA, donde se agrupan genios, el verdadero talón de Aquiles de un gigante de la IA siempre ha sido una sola cosa: cómo domar a un grupo de personas inteligentes con egos enormes. Cuando estos individuos se reúnen, desde ajustes de parámetros hasta decisiones de rumbo, cada uno tiene su propia "verdad". Sin una fuerza restrictiva poderosa...
